scientific.integrity: The primary publisher PDF was read at the model reduction, positive-equilibrium formula, Theorems 3.2–3.5, the rank-one Jacobian, characteristic determinant, and the source's same-sign sufficient condition. The earlier full-text stem-cell control model and the experimental/Markov phenotypic-equilibrium literature were compared for implication coverage. The bundled checker independently reconstructs a mixed-sign parameter example with exact arithmetic. The day-resolved first-public-date field follows the OpenAlex bibliographic record; the archival publisher page reports online publication only to May 2017. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is a local Jacobian classification for the finite-state model after assumptions (A1)–(A3). It does not prove global convergence, does not cover mother-state-dependent transition probabilities before (A3), and leaves nonlinear behavior at the nonhyperbolic case beta'(N0)=0 unclassified.

title: Decreasing feedback alone stabilizes every finite-state equilibrium in the Situ–Lei stem-cell model
